title: objectstack-data skill: teach the .custom package's object-extension arrangement (fieldGroups and relatedLists) from PR #36517
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Filed as a `finding` by seat `repo:objectstack#2`. This is the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` carrier for PR #36517 (card #36498). Not triaged; not claimed.

## What is owed

PR #36517 adds `Metadata-protocol: added`. The object extension of a base's paired `.custom` package may now write `fieldGroups` and `relatedLists`. Each key it writes replaces the arrangement whole, `{ list, hidden: true }` hides a relationship tab, and every other package is refused and prescribed `place`.

The object-extension section of `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` does not mention either key. AI authors therefore will not use them, and may write them on a non-`.custom` extension, where the doors now refuse them.

## Scope

- One short paragraph in the object-extension section of `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, paid for under the skill's byte ratchet.
- One eval case: a `.custom` arrangement accepted, and a non-`.custom` writer told to use `place`.
- `domain:skills`, after #36517 merges.

Re-check: `grep -n "relatedLists" skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` names the `.custom` arrangement.
